name: phase331-nim-llama31-unsettled-receipt-alert
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. A deterministic runtime finds a durable model completion receipt that remains unsettled because its snapshotted permit cannot be reconciled. The cycle stops before scheduler dispatch. Operations should expose a read-only alert with pending count and oldest receipt age, but neither an operator nor a model may bypass settlement or mark it settled. Exact keys/types: alert=true; scheduler_dispatch=false; bypass_allowed=false; model_authority=false; canonical_writes=0. Do not choose recovery, settlement, accounting, routing, retries, or writes.
